name: boloss
description: BOLOSS - Jeu de cartes web 1v1 (MVP). Server-authoritative card game with Socket.io + React.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @boloss/server && npm run build -w @boloss/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @boloss/server && npm run typecheck -w @boloss/client
